bio: Marco Venier stands at the intersection of Venice's rigid class boundaries, wielding his engineer's mind to reshape societal structures that have stood for centuries. Once merely a talented glassmith with radical ideas, he has risen to prominence through his revolutionary 'opportunity markets' - carefully orchestrated collaborations that pair noble investment with common ingenuity.
